title: Satin column 2 mm wide: no split, the same crossings
description: A 40 × 2 mm rectangle sewn as satin across the 2 mm at density 4.5, under sewing off: PE-DESIGN keeps one crossing per rung up to 15 mm (no split stitches), so the count is the same for every width and only the crossing length changes.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: Fill Stitch and Satin Stitch: Density, Pull compensation, Under sewing, Direction, Step pitch, Gradation
PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference stitches/sweep-satin-width-2.pes (pe-gui, 2026-10-27; stitch-sweeps track S3/S4/S6/S8)

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 2 mm rectangle with the Rectangle tool from (10, 10) to (50, 12) mm. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Satin Stitch, Direction Manual straight line 90°, Under sewing unticked, Density 4.5, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Half Stitch at its default, every other attribute at PE-DESIGN's default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
